snippet.title: Still Waters | Creepy Poolrooms Liminal Horror Game | PC
snippet.description:
Still Waters | Creepy Poolrooms Liminal Horror Game | PC
#backrooms #gaming #demo #liminalspace #amazing #photorealism 

Store - https://dk-productions.itch.io/still-waters-liminal-psyhcological-horror

The game is now twice as big!

Hey everyone,

I’ve just released a huge update for my liminal horror game! The game is now twice as big, with tons of new rooms, sounds, and things to explore.

What’s new?

Many new areas to discover
More eerie sounds
New Set of Rooms
Added a optional Download with Reshade (Recommended). It adds some VHS Effect, Lens distortion, and some nice other little touches.
Redid all Water Sounds
Entirely New Spawn Area
If you’ve played before, there’s a lot of fresh content waiting for you. And if you haven’t tried it yet – now is the perfect time!

Let me know what you think of the new update! Your feedback is always appreciated.

Enjoy exploring – and watch out for what might be watching you.

Still Waters is a project I had in my mind ever since I played POOLS.

This game is, of course, heavily inspired by POOLS, with a custom touch from DK Productions.

Explore the levels and immerse yourself in the game.

Can you reach the end?

Are you alone?

Go find out yourself...

Still Waters is free to download and was made with GameGuru Classic,
a simple game engine by TGC.

THIS GAME IS A WORK IN PROGRESS AND WILL RECEIVE MORE LEVELS SOON.
